Name: Yandere_Spicy Sebastian Portrait with more Piercings in my artstyle
Author: Mountain05And
Description:
The only difference of this mod and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23877]My older Seb Portrait[/url] are his neutral/smile/blushing expression, I did some adjustment to fit in the personality for Sebastian dialogue mods such as yandere and spicy Seb.

installation:
place the three png file in the Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\your preferred file name
of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture mod
[/url]
Here's a breakdown of the steps:
1) Install required mods (SMAPI, Content Patcher, Portraiture)
2) Create a new folder in the 'Portraits' folder of [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture mod
[/url][i]...for example, if you named your new created folder 'new folder', it should be like: Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\[/i][i]new folder
[/i]...btw my new folder is named VERSION 1 in the preview images up there.
3) Download the rar file of this mod (which contains 3 png), and placed them in the new folder mentioned in step 2.
4) "Press P to change Portrait-Set when the DialogBox is open." - in other words, In game, talk to anyone and Press P to change the portrait set/folders.
